operational_records.description: For applicable 2004/38 family cases: direct Swedish Consulate Istanbul appointment by migration.istanbul@gov.se is expressly offered as alternative to VFS; verify applicability first.
VFS Global is also an optional submission channel for qualifying EU/EEA family member in Türkiye; service fee may apply to VFS channel.
Mission describes proof of family relationship, EU relative identity, and travelling together/joining as core visa supporting documents; list is guidance, not automatic absolute proof restriction.
Written refusal appeal to migration.istanbul@gov.se, published three-week rule and consular reconsideration; competent law is Swedish.
Turkish population-register extracts may be obtained through NVI or authenticated e-Devlet. Official site states electronic extracts have same domestic legal value.
Turkish national passport acquisition procedures and document categories published by NVI.
